metadata.provenance: Byte-exact, independently checkable IPA tie-bar equivalence and comparison-key test vectors. Every row of ELANG steering §7.1 is covered. Only base symbols, combining diacritics and spacing modifiers present in the pinned repertoire (specs/schema/ipa-v1.json) are referenced; no symbols are invented. Tie bars are U+0361 (upper, COMBINING DOUBLE INVERTED BREVE) and U+035C (lower, COMBINING DOUBLE BREVE BELOW). The comparison key normalizes U+035C to U+0361 for uniqueness while the authored tie variant and NFC bytes are preserved verbatim in `original`.

positive.name: untied-two-units
positive.description: t + ʃ untied: two separate logical base units.

positive.name: tied-upper-one-unit
positive.description: t + U+0361 + ʃ tied by the upper tie bar: one logical base unit.
positive.steering_row: t͡ʃ (t + U+0361 + ʃ) tied, 1 logical unit

positive.name: tied-lower-one-unit
positive.description: t + U+035C + ʃ tied by the lower tie bar: one logical base unit; the authored lower tie bar is preserved in `original`.
positive.steering_row: t͜ʃ (t + U+035C + ʃ) tie-equivalent to the upper form

positive.name: mixed-tied-then-base
positive.description: Tied unit t͡ʃ followed by the untied base a: mixed, two logical units.

positive.name: two-independent-tied-units
positive.description: Two independent tied units t͡ʃ and d͡ʒ: no chaining, two logical units.
positive.steering_row: t͡ʃd͡ʒ independent tied units, 2 logical units

positive.name: tied-unit-modifier-after-second-base
positive.description: Tied unit t͡ʃ with the aspiration modifier ʰ correctly placed after the second base: one logical unit.
positive.steering_row: t͡ʃʰ modifier correctly after tied second base

equivalence.name: upper-lower-tie-equivalent
equivalence.description: Upper (U+0361) and lower (U+035C) tie bars MUST share a comparison key for uniqueness.

equivalence.name: tied-vs-untied-distinct
equivalence.description: Tied t͡ʃ and untied tʃ are distinct identities and MUST NOT share a comparison key.
equivalence.steering_row: tʃ untied vs t͡ʃ tied are distinct

negative.name: modifier-between-tied-bases
negative.description: A modifier ʰ sits before the tie bar, so the tie no longer joins two bare bases: invalid placement.

negative.name: two-modifications-on-one-base
negative.description: Two spacing modifications (ʰ then ʷ) on a single base unit.
negative.steering_row: tʰʷ invalid: 2 modifications on one base

negative.name: standalone-spacing-modifier
negative.description: A spacing modifier ʰ with no preceding base.

negative.name: standalone-combining-mark
negative.description: An isolated combining tilde U+0303 with no preceding base.
negative.steering_row: isolated U+0303 invalid standalone combining mark
